dogecoin.text: @AltcoinDailyio PSA for those new to crypto.  Unlike BTC, Dogecoin has no fixed supply. Instead, there is a steady supply of about 10,000 mined every minute, which is over 5 billion doge every year. If you do not find this concerning, then welcome to the memecoin world of musical chairs. https://t.co/pDbj0jxmEY

@Cometdefi PSA. 60% of the Dogecoin supply is in the hands of about 100 people.  The supply of Dogecoin increases by 5,000,000,000 every year and always will. If you know this to be true, why would you park your wealth there when there is Cardano with a fixed supply and a fair distribution
